changes: Rebuilt `/panel` as a Components V2 message: welcome text with a misuse warning, one description block per ticket type with guidance notes, a Quick Select section with a 'More Info' link button to the wiki, and a ticket-category select menu.

Added required question forms for every ticket type — picking Java Farm, Bedrock Farm, Report a Bug, Report a Person, Partnership or Management opens a modal whose 5 questions are all mandatory before the ticket is created.

Java/Bedrock Farm questions (exactly 5 fields, the modal cap): server version & client · single player or multiplayer (essentials mod / server / realm) · detailed problem description · combined video link + Download Number (DN) · mods or plugins (server & client side). The schematic file stays optional and is attached in the ticket channel.
Bug report questions: describe the bug, steps to reproduce, server version, links to screenshots or videos, and how often it happens.
Report a Person questions: username(s) of the reported player(s), what they did, when it happened, links to evidence, and witnesses.
Partnership questions: channel/community name, links, a short pitch, average views or members, and anything else we should know.
Management questions: explain your request or concern, who is involved, when it happened, supporting evidence or context, and the outcome you are asking for.
The answers from the question form are now filled into the ticket's welcome embed, so staff see all the context the moment the ticket is created.

Automatic staff assignment: when a ticket is created, Mihulish scores the answers (DN, video link, problem description) plus the ticket panel against expertise tags and keywords (java, bedrock, bug, report, partnership, management), prefers the least-loaded matching staff member, claims the ticket for them and DMs them.

Improved claiming: tickets now have a 🙋 Claim ticket button that only staff can press; it locks once claimed (nobody else can claim — a manager must /transfer), and the panel message's button flips to its green 'Claimed' state. `/claim` and `/transfer` now reject double-claims with clear messages and mention the previous owner on transfers.

Transcripts are now also posted to a dedicated ticket transcript channel set via `/settings ticket_transcripts:<#channel>` (slash command and `m.settings ticket_transcripts` prefix command), alongside the mod-log.

When a ticket is closed or deleted, the creator receives the transcript in their DMs together with a 1-5 ⭐ rating form; ratings are stored on the ticket row and logged to the transcript and log channels.
The panel is wrapped in a Container component with the brand accent color, so it has the same colored background style as the TheySix changelog messages.

Panel and select-menu entries are now ordered: Java Farm, Bedrock Farm, Report a Bug, Report a Person, Partnership, Management. The management panel is also seeded for existing guilds, so it appears in the menu (it was missing).

Tickets must be closed before they can be deleted, guaranteeing a transcript always exists first; closing, reopening and deleting are staff-only actions, and the 'Ticket closed' notice no longer shows a duplicate button row.

Fixed /panel failing with 'MESSAGE_CANNOT_USE_LEGACY_FIELDS_WITH_COMPONENTS_V2' (the Components V2 payload no longer gets an automatic 'Done.' content field), a crash when opening a ticket modal, and /transfer failing when the users mentioned were the same.
